nmp-01-hero-land-crouch.title: HERO-LAND CROUCH (grounded landing, feet planted)
nmp-01-hero-land-crouch.method: RIG-ANGLE snap.figure, easeInOutCubic, 7 inbetweens/transition, 2 breakdowns/transition, overshoot+settle real frames
nmp-01-hero-land-crouch.distinct_from: L fist down-forward over torso (chest pass), R arm swept back, deep asymmetric crouch. Not jump-land (arms-up) and not gul-01 compact crouch (both hands out).
nmp-01-hero-land-crouch.classification: ADDITIVE / EXTRA — not a production blocker

nmp-02-sky-point-salute.title: SKY-POINT SALUTE (grounded standing)
nmp-02-sky-point-salute.method: RIG-ANGLE snap.figure, easeInOutCubic, 7 inbetweens/transition, 2 breakdowns/transition, overshoot+settle real frames
nmp-02-sky-point-salute.distinct_from: L arm straight up pointing at the sky, R hand on hip, head tilted up to the pointing hand. Not jei-03 side-point (sideways) and not cap-01 entrance.
nmp-02-sky-point-salute.classification: ADDITIVE / EXTRA — not a production blocker

nmp-03-prowl-step.title: PROWL STEP (grounded low crouch, moving forward)
nmp-03-prowl-step.method: RIG-ANGLE snap.figure, easeInOutCubic, 7 inbetweens/transition, 2 breakdowns/transition, overshoot+settle real frames
nmp-03-prowl-step.distinct_from: Asymmetric prowl: L arm reaching forward low over torso, R arm back, deep step-crouch. Not gul-02 focus (symmetric hands out) and not bur-01 dash (upright lean).
nmp-03-prowl-step.classification: ADDITIVE / EXTRA — not a production blocker

nmp-04-overhead-smash-windup.title: OVERHEAD SMASH WINDUP (grounded braced)
nmp-04-overhead-smash-windup.method: RIG-ANGLE snap.figure, easeInOutCubic, 7 inbetweens/transition, 2 breakdowns/transition, overshoot+settle real frames
nmp-04-overhead-smash-windup.distinct_from: Both arms overhead and slightly inward (clasped-smash windup), legs braced wide, head forward-down. Not cap-02 spread (arms sideways) and not flex (arms bent at sides).
nmp-04-overhead-smash-windup.classification: ADDITIVE / EXTRA — not a production blocker
